questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes “polymer”?

options.label: A
options.text: A large macromolecule composed of repeating structural units called monomers linked together by covalent bonds.

options.label: B
options.text: A rapid polymerization process where monomers add sequentially to an active growing chain end (radical, cation, or anion) without forming small byproducts.

options.label: C
options.text: A chain-growth polymerization initiated by free radicals that repeatedly add to vinyl monomers to form polymers such as polyethylene and polystyrene.

options.label: D
options.text: A polymerization process where multifunctional monomers react stepwise to form dimers, trimers, and oligomers, often eliminating small molecules like water.

questions.correct_answer: A large macromolecule composed of repeating structural units called monomers linked together by covalent bonds.

questions.question: You need to distinguish “Ziegler–Natta catalyst” from several related chapter concepts. Which description uniquely identifies it?

options.text: A polymer stereoisomer where all substituent groups are positioned on the same side of the extended polymer backbone chain.
